name: Detour measurement
statement: Detour ratio DR = actual distance / recommended-route distance; extra distance = actual minus recommended. Actual distance comes from the recorded trip distance, else a road-matched path, never the sum of straight lines between sparse pings (that sum may only prove a detour, never disprove one). Spatial confirmation needs at least CORRIDOR_MIN_CONSEC_PINGS consecutive pings beyond CORRIDOR_HALF_WIDTH_M of the recommended route, ignoring ENDPOINT_EXCLUSION_M at both ends.
